title: Terminate the Agent loop when its cycle budget is exhausted
goal: A bounded M6 run must not return a continuing evaluation while leaving the goal active after maxCycles is exhausted.
context: M6Orchestrator currently exits the while loop when cycleCount reaches maxCycles and returns the last Evaluation unchanged. If the last disposition is .continue, the goal remains active and the caller receives a non-terminal result with no remaining cycles.
forbidden_changes: Do not change normal continue-then-complete semantics before the final cycle.
Do not add unbounded retries or alter UI/provider/Skill behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A final .continue at maxCycles becomes an explicit abort before evaluation/state persistence.
Regression test proves exactly maxCycles cycles run and authoritative goal status becomes aborted.
One logical task per commit; report actual CI separately.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if existing continuation tests regress or CI fails.
